title: 599. Minimum Index Sum of Two Lists

examples.input: list1 = ["Shogun","Tapioca Express","Burger King","KFC"], list2 = ["Piatti","The Grill at Torrey Pines","Hungry Hunter Steakhouse","Shogun"]

examples.explanation: The common string with the least index sum is "Shogun" with index sum = (0 + 1) = 1.

There are three common strings: "happy" with index sum = (0 + 1) = 1. "sad" with index sum = (1 + 0) = 1. "good" with index sum = (2 + 2) = 4. The strings with the least index sum are "sad" and "happy".
